scope: SEL03 six core records; inventory is not canon approval

sites.name: The Imperial Seat (Rose Empire)
sites.desc: Capital of the Rose Empire on the northern continent, built on seven hills with the Rose Palace on the centre one. Here Shai rebuilds the emperor’s soul in The Emperor’s Soul.

sites.name: Mulla’dil
sites.desc: A mountainous province of the Rose Empire whose Strikers guard the passes to Teod.

sites.name: Dzhamar
sites.desc: The swampy province of the Bloodsealers.

sites.name: MaiPon
sites.desc: Shai’s homeland and the heart of Forgery; its position in the empire is not given.

event.title: The Emperor’s Soul
event.text: A condemned Forger is given a hundred days to rebuild the soul of a dying emperor.

shai.name: Shai
shai.desc: A thief who rewrites the history of objects, and one emperor.

jindo.name: JinDo
jindo.desc: A land south-east of Arelon, related in culture to MaiPon. The city of HaiKo lies in its north-east.

related.selShort: The world of Elantris and The Emperor’s Soul.

facts: AonDor, Forgery, Dakhor and more, tied to the land
